fit_reason: Whole car listed by a private seller.
findings: Dull, hazy finish on the hood and front bumper in the front shots
Light dust and film on the rear hatch and bumper below the Fiesta badge

message: Hi, we saw your Fiesta listing on Marketplace. The paint on the hood and rear hatch looks a little dull and dusty in the photos, and the headlights have some haze that a restoration would clear up. We do mobile pre-sale details and buffing that come to you. Would you like a quote?
